Write literal weights into a recurrent neural network to execute one instruction of a register machine at each tick. The state z contains two nonnegative integer registers R0,R1 and four one-hot program counter bits P0..P3. State vector ORDER is ["P0", "P1", "P3", "P2", "R1", "R0"]. One tick is z_new=ReLU(D @ z + E @ ReLU(W @ z)), ReLU componentwise. D is 6x6, W is 2x6, E is 6x2. The returned z_new has the same coordinate order. At active instruction pc j, inc(r,t) means increment register r and jump to t; dec(r,z,p) means if r=0 jump to z, otherwise subtract one from r and jump to p. halt means keep everything unchanged. All other registers retain their values. The program in pc order 0 to 3 is [["dec", 1, 2, 3], ["halt"], ["inc", 1, 3], ["dec", 0, 1, 0]]. Write the cell for all register values and all four starting PCs. Return ONLY JSON object with keys D,W,E, whose values are arrays of [zero-based row,zero-based col,value] triples. Unlisted entries of these FINAL matrices are set to zero. No tools or code in the reply.
